import json, os, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from aelix_analytics import core, workspace
from aelix_analytics.publishing import build
root = Path(sys.argv[1]); origin = core.Origin('human','cli')
if sys.argv[2] == 'create':
    p=core.init_project(root,title='합성 3000 finding · 10 publication',origin=origin)
    rows=[{'schema':'analytics.event/2','seq':n,'id':f'e{n}','recorded_at':'2026-10-22T00:00:00+00:00','kind':'finding','actor':'human','text':f'Synthetic finding {n} with enough public content for timeline.','refs':[]} for n in range(1,3001)]
    p.journal.write_bytes(b''.join(json.dumps(row).encode()+b'\n' for row in rows))
    for n in range(10): build.build_publication(p,origin=origin)
    print(json.dumps({'created':True,'builds':10})); sys.exit()
p=core.Project(root)
observations=[]
for n in range(2):
    start=time.perf_counter(); workspace.build(p); normal=time.perf_counter()-start
    start=time.perf_counter(); skipped=workspace.build(p,if_changed=True); fast=time.perf_counter()-start
    start=time.perf_counter(); core.record(p,'finding',f'Synthetic recorded value {n}',origin=origin); workspace.build(p); record=time.perf_counter()-start
    observations.append({'render_seconds':normal,'if_changed_seconds':fast,'skipped':skipped.get('skipped',False),'record_and_render_seconds':record})
print(json.dumps({'source':sys.argv[3],'python':sys.version,'observations':observations,'package_bytes':sum(x.stat().st_size for x in (root/'.analytics/publications').rglob('*') if x.is_file())}))

import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tarfile, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path.cwd(); out=repo/'.devstate/runs/7397fe0a-2fa9-465a-ae18-76caccbfee2e/evidence'
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='pr120-perf-') as tmp:
    scratch=Path(tmp); baseline=scratch/'baseline'; baseline.mkdir()
    archive=scratch/'baseline.tar'; archive.write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','archive','e04ddbc']))
    with tarfile.open(archive) as t: t.extractall(baseline,filter='data')
    def call(source,project,mode,label):
        env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('LAB_','AELIX_LAB_'))}
        env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(source/'src'),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',AELIX_ANALYTICS_TRUST_FILE=str(scratch/'trust.json'))
        return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([sys.executable,str(repo/'.devstate/perf_pr120.py'),str(project),mode,label],env=env,text=True))
    call(baseline,scratch/'fixture','create','e04ddbc')
    results=[]
    for label,source in [('e04ddbc',baseline),('fixes',repo)]:
        project=scratch/label; shutil.copytree(scratch/'fixture',project)
        results.append(call(source,project,'measure',label))
    (out/'fixes-performance.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
    print(json.dumps(results,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
